question:
Study the given graph and answer the question that follows.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b74b4bddad8f1ad641f17e9b5f14a915b662b55e68299ee47c7ff9ccde975328.png] 

The average exports of country ABC in 2015, 2017 and 2018 are what percentage of the total imports from 2015 to 2018 (correct to one decimal place)?
solution:
**Given:**

There is the import and export of country ABC from 2015 to 2019 (in crores) in the given graph.

**Calculation:**

The average exports of country ABC in 2015, 2017 and 2018 = (150 + 200 + 280)/3 = 630/3 = 210

The total imports of country ABC from 2015 to 2018 = (180 + 200 + 250 +320) = 950

The percentage = (210/950) × 100 = 22.10...% ≈ 22.1% (correct to one decimal place)

**The average exports of country ABC in 2015, 2017, and 2018 are 22.1% of the total imports from 2015 to 2018**
